verdict.rationale: Drata's developer portal claims you can 'automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions' that monitor controls, evidence, and personnel. That is a first-party claim of event-triggered rule automation, but it is a single marketing line with no supporting documentation. Custom monitoring tests and CRUD API endpoints are adjacent building blocks, not a rule/trigger engine, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of how rules are defined, which events can trigger them, which actions are available, any outbound execution (e.g., webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
